notes: 2026-11-25 review fail by reviewer: Blocking: apps/web/e2e/pay.spec.ts:869 adds .first() to the How to get it back click. This hides a duplicate status on the page this task fixes. The new lateInFull case (closed, payable 0, held 1,250, one late deposit) now renders two held lines for the same money: 'Closed before the full amount arrived. 1,250.00 USDC is held for you.' (pay-status.tsx:82, closedPartial) and '1,250.00 USDC arrived after the checkout closed' (pay-box.tsx:328, pay.late > 0n), each with its own How to get it back button. That breaks R-68 'no duplicate status' and the test's own title 'every held payment gets one short line', and .first() also drops the one-button guard for the other five held cases. Fix: do not render the late HeldNote when pay.state is closedPartial (its line already counts late held money), e.g. pay-box.tsx:328 'pay.late > 0n && pay.state !== PAY_STATES.closedPartial', and restore the strict .click() without .first(). Checked and fine: payState change (pay.ts:139,168) is correct; earlier branches (paid, review, canceled, checking, confirming, closing) still win; canSend, delayed, clockRuns and pay-box seen behave as intended; the only payState caller is pay-invoice.tsx (pay page and embed), link pay does not use it. The unit test fails against the pre-fix pay.ts (state 'checking'; run with a scratch vitest config aliasing the origin/main copy) and passes now (31/31). The e2e case fails before the fix. Line 3: data-motion=essential matches base.css:127 and docs/web/DESIGN.md:1399 and the existing payment-journey/payment-sum spinners; a kept reduced-motion test would only check styling, so the recorded one-off measurement is acceptable under Which tests to keep. Nit: line 3 is a change independent of the closed-page fix and could have been its own task (docs/workflow.md step 2).

2026-11-25 review pass by reviewer: Re-review after the fix. The blocking finding is fixed: pay-box.tsx:328 hides the late note in closedPartial, and pay.spec.ts uses a strict How to get it back click again, so each held case shows one button. No other closedPartial case loses money information: the backend always sends amounts (ledger.ReadAmountsFor returns a row for every invoice; get.go sets inv.Amounts), so a closed checkout's received is payable 0 + held, and held already contains the late money (pay.late is capped at held). On-time 400 + late 600 shows 1,000 held, the right total; only the on-time/late split is gone, and both parts go back through the same support path. The other late cases still show the note (closed with nothing received, canceled, open or paid). Note, not blocking: if amounts were missing (the schema allows it, this backend never sends it), received would count only on-time money and the late money would vanish from the page. payState change, unit test (fails on the pre-fix pay.ts), e2e case and the reduced-motion spinners were checked in the first review and are unchanged. Pay unit tests 101/101 pass; verify passed at 20:56.

proof.1: e2e: pay.spec.ts "every held payment gets one short line": a late-only full payment, closed with payable 0 and held 1,250.00, shows one line, "Closed before the full amount arrived. 1,250.00 USDC is held for you.", with one How to get it back button (strict click). The "arrived after the checkout closed" note is not repeated. web-unit pay.test.ts "says a checkout closed, with its money held, once the held money reaches the amount" pins the state: closedPartial, not "checking" as before the fix.
proof.2: e2e: the same e2e loop checks that no held case shows "is confirming the transfer" or "Awaiting confirmation". The late-only full payment case failed before the fix.
proof.3: e2e: the pay page status and phone transaction row spinners carry data-motion="essential" (base.css exempts it from reduced motion), and the pay status loses its motion-safe: prefix. A one-off Playwright run of the pay page under reduced motion read the Payment found spinner as fw-spin 0.9s infinite; without the change it was animation none. The phone row (signed-in app) has the same attribute and class and was not measured. Landing e2e still passes: the shared status pill stays still under reduced motion. Not kept, per Which tests to keep.

tasks.behavior: Bun installs the workspace in place of pnpm; Node still runs the apps and tests
acceptance: A clean clone installs with bun install --frozen-lockfile from one committed bun.lock; the pnpm lockfile and workspace file are gone, and the workspaces, overrides and blocked install scripts carry over.
Every required and CI-only check passes locally with Bun as the package manager, lane by lane as staging CI runs them; Node still runs Next.js, Playwright and Vitest.
Staging CI, the web Docker image and the publish workflow install with Bun; the web image builds and its server answers.
A packed @forwend/react depends on @forwend/js by version, not workspace:, so a CI publish stays correct.
D-1, R-1, R-14 and every doc, script and comment name Bun commands; no pnpm command is left.
notes: 2026-11-26 review fail by reviewer: Blocking: .npmrc.example:3 documents npm publish "$(cd packages/node && bun pm pack --quiet)". Without --destination, bun pm pack --quiet prints only the file name (forwend-0.2.1.tgz), so npm publish from the root fails with ENOENT (reproduced). Also npm publish <tarball> skips prepublishOnly and bun pm pack runs only prepack/prepare, so packages/node/package.json:29 prepublishOnly (bun run build) no longer runs on any publish path; a hand publish from a clean clone ships no dist/ (gitignored). Fix: rename packages/node prepublishOnly to prepack (bun pm pack runs it), and make the command resolve, e.g. npm publish "$(cd packages/node && bun pm pack --destination "$PWD" --quiet)". Checked fine: overrides resolve to the same ws/uuid/decode-uri-component versions as pnpm; trustedDependencies [] blocks only the same 4 scripts (bun pm untrusted); frozen dry-run exit 0; Dockerfile filtered frozen install works (simulated, tsc/next/turbo present); setup-bun SHA = v2.2.0 and reads packageManager; setup-node kept; CI pack with --destination prints an absolute path, provenance/auth intact; config.json argv map to the right package folders and scripts; bunx resolves turbo/playwright/next with node shebang; Bun honors the file: override in check-browser-packages; bun run passes -flags and stdin (canary -h works); lint exit 0; unittest 68 OK; no pnpm left outside D-1.

2026-11-26 review pass by reviewer: Re-review after fixes. .npmrc.example:3 now packs with --destination "$PWD" (expanded after cd), so it prints one absolute path. packages/node, js and react use prepack: bun run build, and bun pm pack runs it. A real pack of each package prints exactly one line, so tarball=$(...) in publish.yml stays a clean path; tsc prints nothing to stdout, and stderr carries bun's $ lines. check-browser-packages.mjs only rebuilds dist again (its pack stdout is ignored). CI publish rebuilds after turbo with the same deps built; npm publish <tarball> runs no scripts. ci.yml cache: actions/cache SHA-pinned, path ~/.bun/install/cache is Bun's default when BUN_INSTALL is unset (setup-bun v2.2.0 sets no BUN_INSTALL), key on bun.lock; publish.yml stays uncached. Nit: the hand command leaves packages/node/forwend-<v>.tgz untracked and not gitignored; a temp --destination would avoid it. Earlier checks still hold: overrides, trustedDependencies, Dockerfile filtered install, setup-bun pin, config.json map, no pnpm left.

proof.1: build: bun install migrated pnpm-lock.yaml into bun.lock with the same versions (ws 7.5.13 and 8.21.0+, uuid 11.1.1, decode-uri-component 0.5.0); pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml are deleted. bun.lock keeps the three range-scoped overrides; bun pm untrusted lists the same four blocked install scripts (bufferutil, utf-8-validate, keccak, @reown/appkit); the layout is isolated (configVersion 1). bun install --frozen-lockfile from an empty node_modules takes 1.8-1.9 s (pnpm warm: 2.6-7.3 s).
proof.2: e2e: check --ci --fresh, lane by lane with Bun on PATH: lane main passed harness, docs-check, lint, typecheck, build, e2e and browser-packages; lane unit passed unit. symbolic failed only on a missing pipx on this Mac; the same halmos 0.3.3 command through uvx passed 6 of 6. Next.js, Playwright (bun x keeps the node shebang) and Vitest still run on Node.
proof.3: build: ci.yml and publish.yml use oven-sh/setup-bun pinned to v2.2.0 by SHA, with bun-version-file package.json, and keep setup-node for Node. ci.yml caches ~/.bun/install/cache keyed on bun.lock (actions/cache v6.1.0 by SHA); publish.yml has no cache. docker build -f infra/web.Dockerfile passed with bun install --frozen-lockfile; the container runs node v26.13.1 and answered GET / with 200 and the Forwend title, and /pay/not-a-token with 404. Staging CI runs at the next promotion.
proof.4: browser-packages: the check packs both packages with bun pm pack and fails on any workspace: range; the packed @forwend/react depends on "@forwend/js": "^0.1.1", as pnpm wrote it. Both tarballs install, render on the server and type-check. CI publishes the bun-packed tarball with npm publish --provenance. By hand, the .npmrc.example command packs with a full path; prepack builds dist (node, js, react); npm publish --dry-run of forwend 0.2.1 from an empty dist listed 10 dist files.
proof.5: docs-check: D-1, R-1 and R-14 name Bun; git grep -w pnpm outside bun.lock and the task record finds only D-1 saying Bun installs faster than pnpm did.
